IS-DG512HS10-4F-2A
12-port Gigabit DIN-Rail Managed Layer 2/4 Lightning Protected Hot-Swap Power Industrial Ethernet Switch
The IS-DG512HS10-4F-2A Series are full Gigabit Ethernet Switches
with 12 Gigabit Ethernet ports, perfect for upgrading an existing
network to a full Gigabit speed Infrastructure; a full Gigabit network
provides higher throughput than legacy Fast Ethernet network. These
models reduce the response time for timing sensitive applications
which may combine all video, voice, and data streams in the traffic
flow. With the powerful S/W and H/W features. The switches prioritize,
partition and optimize user’s network while provide reliable and quality
services. The IS-DG512HS10-4F-2A Series switches are suitable for
all kinds of Industrial applications.
Key features
►► ►►
Hot-swappable redundant power Input 100/240 VAC, 50Hz ~ 60Hz IEEE 802.1X Port-based access control / RADIUS /
►►
8 Gigabit RJ45 Copper ports plus 4 100 / 1000 Based TACACS+ Server
►►
SFP(SX/LX/LHX/ZX) ports VeriPHY Cable Diagnostics, Per VLAN mirroring
►► ►►
Support 9K Jumbo frames AC Power Input 100/240 VAC, 50Hz ~ 60Hz
►► ►►
Layer 2 Line-Speed Switching Fabric, non-blocking 10KV Lightning Protection (Power Module)
